products.note: Industrial single and multicore control cables are used for interconnecting electrical equipment and control systems in industries.
Housing wires are catered to residential requirements. They are designed to managelow-voltage applications and ensure reliable power distribution for lighting, appliances, and other utilities.
Welding cables are flexible, heavy-duty cables designed to carry high current from welding machines to welding tools. They are resistant to heat, oil, abrasion, and mechanical stress.
Solar cables are specially designed to connect solar panels and other components in photovoltaic systems. They offer resistance to UV radiation, weather conditions, and temperature variations.
Submersible flat cables are specially designed for use with submersible pumps in deep wells and borewells. They are resistant to water, abrasion, and harsh environmental conditions.

risks: We have not entered into long-term agreements with most of our raw material suppliers.
If we are unable to procure adequate quantities of raw materials or at competitive prices, our business, results of operations and financial condition may be adversely affected.
Any increase or fluctuation in prices of our raw materials, may have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations and financial condition.
We usually procure raw materials from our major suppliers either under formal agreements or on a short-term basis through purchase orders, and we do not enter into long-term contracts with them.
Any reduction of supplies or discontinuation or delay of supplies from any of such suppliers may adversely affect our financial performance and results of operations.
Our operations are dependent upon the price and availability of raw materials that we require for the manufacturing of our cables and wires.

The raw materials used in our manufacturing process are Aluminium & Copper Wire and Rods, Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC), Cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE), GI Strips/Wires & Packing wooden drums, which are prone to price fluctuations.

The following table sets forth the details of our total cost of goods sold for the periods indicated: Particulars August 31,2026 FY 2025-26 FY 2024-25 FY 2023-24 Cost of Goods sold (₹ in lakhs) 9,405.39 17,915.93 12,337.00 7994.53 Cost of Goods sold as a Percentage of Revenue from Operations (%) 83.21% 85.12% 88.25% 90.50% These raw materials are subject to supply disruptions and are very volatile due to price fluctuations resulting from, domestic and foreign trade policies, shifts in supply and demand, competition and other factors beyond our control.

overview.business_overview:
Our Company was originally established as a partnership firm in the year 2012 under the name M/s. Johnson Cables. Over the years, the partnership firm underwent various reconstitutions and was subsequently converted into a private limited company as Johnsoncab Electricals Private Limited on November 12, 2020. Thereafter, the Company was converted into a public limited company and name of the Company was changed from Johnsoncab Electricals Private Limited to Johnsoncab Electricals Limited on December 05, 2025. The Corporate Identification Number (CIN) of our Company is U31900GJ2020PLC118226.

Johnsoncab Electricals Limited (JEL) is engaged in the business of manufacturing of low voltage (up to 1.1 kV) wires and cables deployed across power infrastructure including transmission and distribution, renewable energy integration, railways and allied industrial application. Our product portfolio includes Control Cables, Power cables, Industrial Single and Multicore Control Cables, Housing/ Building Wires and Special-purpose Power Cables including Welding Cable, Solar / Photovoltaic Cables, Submersible Flat Cables. We manufacture and sell our products under the name “JOHNSON CABLES”. Our company holds ISO and BIS certifications, ensuring the quality standards of our products.

Our Company operates two manufacturing units (Unit I and Unit II) located in Mehsana, Gujarat. As of Fiscal 2026, the combined annual installed manufacturing capacity of both units is 79,950 KMS, as certified by the Independent Chartered Engineer, Raj Techno Essentials, vide its certificate dated September 15, 2026. Our manufacturing facilities are equipped with machinery for wire drawing, annealing, bunching, insulation, extrusion, testing and packaging, enabling us to manufacture wires and cables across multiple specifications. Over the years, we have upgraded our manufacturing facilities through the installation of automatic and semi-automatic machinery and equipment to enhance our production capabilities. Our Company caters to both private sector customers and government entities. We secure orders directly through participation in tenders, vendor approval processes. Our revenues from operations for five months ended on August 31,2026 and for Fiscals 2026, 2025 and 2024 were ₹11,303.62 lakhs, ₹21,047.41 lakhs, ₹13,979.13 lakhs and ₹8,833.89 lakhs, respectively. Our EBITDA for five months ended on August 31, 2026 and for Fiscals 2026, 2025 and 2024 was ₹1,532.07 ₹2,406.32 lakhs, ₹1,213.50 lakhs, ₹ 542.09 lakhs respectively. Our profit after tax for five months ended on August 31, 2026 and for Fiscals 2026, 2025 and 2024 was ₹863.36 lakhs, ₹ 1341.95 lakhs, ₹546.44 lakhs and ₹252.30 lakhs, respectively.

For further details, please refer to the section titled “Financial Information” on page no. 294 of this Red Herring Prospectus.

- We usually procure raw materials from our major suppliers either under formal agreements or on a short-term basis through purchase orders, and we do not enter into long-term contracts with them.
- Any reduction of supplies or discontinuation or delay of supplies from any of such suppliers may adversely affect our financial performance and results of operations.
- Our operations are dependent upon the price and availability of raw materials that we require for the manufacturing of our cables and wires.
- The raw materials used in our manufacturing process are Aluminium & Copper Wire and Rods, Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC), Cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE), GI Strips/Wires & Packing wooden drums, which are prone to price fluctuations.
- The following table sets forth the details of our total cost of goods sold for the periods indicated: Particulars August 31,2026 FY 2025-26 FY 2024-25 FY 2023-24 Cost of Goods sold (₹ in lakhs) 9,405.39 17,915.93 12,337.00 7994.53 Cost of Goods sold as a Percentage of Revenue from Operations (%) 83.21% 85.12% 88.25% 90.50% These raw materials are subject to supply disruptions and are very volatile due to price fluctuations resulting from, domestic and foreign trade policies, shifts in supply and demand, competition and other factors beyond our control.
